blockers.evidence: Six legacy iOS Capture APIs are now defined directly in media/capture/src/ios/capture_ios.m, rather than emitted by CMake. Their unsupported/empty-list semantics remain explicit; real iOS static link and device tests are still pending.

Original capture_posix_test under ASan/UBSan with detect_leaks=1 reported 41332 bytes in 28 allocations through pa_context_new_with_proplist -> ma_init_pa_mainloop_and_pa_context__pulse. A miniaudio-only reproducer using an explicitly absent private PulseAudio socket also leaks, without Core/Capture source or physical devices. Static Media consolidation keeps a single miniaudio implementation; it does not waive the original provider leak. Dependency-side qualification: https://github.com/qigao/vcpkg-cache/actions/runs/41761576106 .
blockers.cause: The frozen provider frees its main loop but omits pa_context_unref after connect failure and after waiting for connection fails. Capture destroys every successfully initialized context on the observed paths.
blockers.policy: Use the reviewed vcpkg-cache v0.1.5 dependency fix. Keep PulseAudio and sanitizers enabled; full Media regression and successful device lifecycle remain independent gates.
